tool_signatures.name: vault_inject
tool_signatures.description: Load ranked vault documents into conversation context with token-budget enforcement.

query.description: Optional FTS5 search query to rank documents by relevance.

max_tokens.description: Hard token budget. Overrides vault DB cap. Effective cap = max_tokens * safety_factor.

cap_behavior.description: 'best_effort' (inject as many docs as fit) or 'strict' (error if any doc exceeds cap).

session_token.description: Optional opaque string used as per-session cache key.

max_single_doc_tokens.description: Truncate individual documents to this many tokens. 0 = no per-doc limit.

safety_factor.description: Fraction of max_tokens to use as effective cap (default 0.60 = 60%).
